inputs.name: JPL Horizons API: target 399 Earth seen from the Moon centre (500@301), QUANTITIES 14 (ObsSub-LON/LAT) and 17 (NP.ang)
inputs.notes: Query: COMMAND='399'; OBJ_DATA='NO'; MAKE_EPHEM='YES'; EPHEM_TYPE='OBSERVER'; CENTER='500@301'; START_TIME='2026-12-01 00:00'; STOP_TIME='2028-12-31 23:00'; STEP_SIZE='1h'; QUANTITIES='14,17'; ANG_FORMAT='DEG'; CSV_FORMAT='YES'. ObsSub lon is East-positive (Horizons legend), lat planetodetic; NP.ang is counter-clockwise from true-of-date north = east of north; normalised to lon -180..180, pa 0..360.
